worldcombat.skill.fireblast.summary: Burns a giant glyph into the air - a top bar, a left fall, a right fall lit one stroke at a time - and the strokes themselves flare when it forms. The three strokes are the danger, and the gaps between them can be stood in; the inscribe form projects the same glyph onto the ground, where only the glowing stroke bands keep burning.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.use.0: Write a giant glyph in the air and sear with the true reach of its three strokes
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.use.1: Inscribe the glyph on the ground to seal a route or a gap
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.use.2: A heavy special finisher at range
When the glyph forms it deals %1$s special damage to up to %3$s foes inside the true reach of the three strokes; each stroke is %2$s blocks thick and the gaps between them can be stood in.

The glyph centre can drift up to %1$s blocks off the aim; strokes are %2$s s apart; a target struck by a stroke has a %3$s chance to burn: about 40 s of losing 1/16 of its max HP (at least 1) every 5 s.
The inscribe form projects the glyph onto real ground, where only the %2$s block thick stroke bands burn: standing on them takes %1$s every %4$s s for about %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.inscribe.on: Inscribe: burst power x0.85, but the ground glyph only burns with its glowing stroke bands (the gaps stay safe), +10 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.inscribe.off: Detonate: burst power x1.15, a heavier single hit and a shorter cooldown, but the glyph leaves no ground.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.growth.0: From level %1$s the burst rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.growth.1: From level %1$s the burst rises to %2$s power and the stroke thickness to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.preference.i: On: burst power x0.85, but the ground glyph only burns with its glowing stroke bands (the gaps between strokes stay safe), +10 cooldown; use it to seal ground. Off (detonate): power x1.15, a heavier hit and a shorter cooldown, but the glyph leaves no ground.
worldcombat.skill.fireblast.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: low-health targets rank first, finished with this heavy glyph; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
